# SPA-010: CI changes

Work starts from `next`, matching the current SPA-008 PR. This is partial work:
`typecheck` remains disabled until SPA-008 is incorporated and supplies a passing
`yarn typecheck` command, including `@astrojs/check`.

- `ci.yml`: checks formatting, lint, tests and application build on pull requests;
  reusable by the push workflow so publications require the same checks.
- `storybook.yml`: builds Storybook on pushes, then publishes it, calls the release
  workflow and builds the Docker image. Pull requests never publish or use secrets.
- `release.yml`: retains stable releases on `master`; other branches skip release.
- `storybook-cleanup.yml`: cleans previews on branch deletion, daily, or manually.
  All writes to `gh-pages` share one concurrency group.
- `.nvmrc`: Node 22.22.2 for CI and local development; Docker receives the same
  version as a build argument. Yarn stays at 1.22.22.

Branch previews now live under `previews/<sha256-of-branch-name>/`; the master
Storybook remains at the root. Hashes prevent collisions between branch names.
Publishing replaces that preview instead of preserving stale files. The next root
publication removes legacy preview directories while retaining `previews/`.
Cleanup only removes hash-named preview directories whose branches no longer exist.

The build in the quality job validates the application. The Docker job no longer
installs dependencies or builds outside Docker; its Dockerfile performs the image
build. The unused `WEB_APP` build argument is removed.

## Verification before completion

Run with the Node version in `.nvmrc` and Yarn 1.22.22:

```sh
yarn install --frozen-lockfile
yarn format:check
yarn lint
yarn test:run
yarn build
```

Then incorporate SPA-008, check `yarn typecheck` succeeds, and add it to `ci.yml`.
The format check intentionally checks the entire repository. Existing formatting
failures must be reported and resolved with the team; do not hide them or reformat
the whole application as part of this ticket.

Validate the workflows with actionlint and GitHub Actions. Test Storybook
publication and deletion on a temporary branch after the workflows reach the
repository's default branch (scheduled/deletion cleanup uses that branch).
